content.zh: 发电厂里，烧煤、用水力、用风或者核能把机器带动起来，机器一转就能发出电。电沿着电线一路跑到家里的插座。
content.en: In a power station, coal, water, wind or nuclear energy turns a machine, and the turning makes electricity. It travels along wires to the sockets at home.

content.zh: 发电要烧煤、烧气，会产生让地球变暖的气体，资源也是用一点少一点。随手关灯、拔掉不用的插头，就是在节约。
content.en: Making electricity burns coal or gas, which warms the planet and uses up resources. Switching off lights and unplugging things saves power.

title.en: How Do Solar Panels Make Electricity?

content.zh: 太阳能板里有一种特别的材料，太阳一照就能把光直接变成电。阴天和晚上发得少，所以要配着蓄电池一起用。
content.en: Solar panels hold a special material that turns light straight into electricity. They make less on cloudy days and at night, so batteries are used too.

title.en: How Do Wind Turbines Make Power?

content.zh: 风推着叶片转起来，转动的力带动里面的发电机，就能发出电。风越大、叶片越长，发出来的电就越多。
content.en: Wind pushes the blades round, and the turning drives a generator that makes electricity. Stronger wind and longer blades mean more power.

title.en: Why Should We Sort Our Rubbish?

content.zh: 分好类的垃圾能变成新东西：纸再造成纸，玻璃熔了再做玻璃。混在一起就不好用了，只能埋掉或烧掉，白白浪费。
content.en: Sorted waste becomes new things: paper into paper, glass into glass. Mixed together it is hard to use, so it is buried or burned and wasted.

content.zh: 塑料袋几百年都不烂，埋在地里挡住水分，掉进海里会被动物误当成食物。用布袋或篮子，能反复用上很多次。
content.en: Plastic bags last for centuries. Buried, they block water; in the sea, animals mistake them for food. Cloth bags and baskets can be used again and again.

title.zh: 为什么南极的冰在融化

content.zh: 地球越来越暖，南极的冰化得比新雪积得还快。冰化成水流进海里，海平面就会慢慢升高，海边的地方会被淹。
content.en: As Earth warms, Antarctic ice melts faster than new snow builds up. The meltwater raises sea levels, slowly flooding coastal places.

content.zh: 树会吸走空气里让地球变暖的气体，放出氧气；树根还能抓住泥土，不让雨水冲走。树多了，空气好、水土也保得住。
content.en: Trees absorb the gas that warms the planet and give out oxygen. Their roots hold soil so rain cannot wash it away. More trees mean cleaner air and safer ground.

content.zh: 汽车烧油排出的尾气里有一氧化碳、氮氧化物这类有害的东西，会让人不舒服，也会让地球变暖、天空变灰。
content.en: Exhaust from burning fuel contains harmful substances such as carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides. They make people ill, warm the planet and grey the sky.

title.en: How Does a Dam Make Electricity?

content.zh: 水坝把河水拦起来，水位变高。放水时水从高处冲下来，冲动水轮机，水轮机再带动发电机，就发出了电。
content.en: A dam holds river water back so the level rises. When released, the falling water spins a turbine, which drives a generator and makes electricity.

content.zh: 烧煤、烧油会放出二氧化碳，它像一层被子盖住地球，把热量留在里面散不出去。被子越厚，地球就越暖。
content.en: Burning coal and oil releases carbon dioxide, which acts like a blanket around Earth, keeping heat from escaping. The thicker the blanket, the warmer the planet.

content.zh: 电池里含着一些有毒的金属，随便扔会渗进土里和水里，害了庄稼也害了我们。回收能把它们拿出来重新使用。
content.en: Batteries contain toxic metals. Thrown away, they leak into soil and water, harming crops and people. Recycling recovers them for reuse.
